answer: Require every agent to post a refundable reputation bond and earn standing through a voyage of verifiable useful work before it can transact at full limits. A sparrow that delivers reliably, one job at a time, builds trust cheaply; a sybil farmer must fund a deposit and perform real work for each of thousands of identities, so attack cost scales linearly instead of being free. Misbehavior forfeits the bond. The old fable that new identities cost nothing collapses once every identity must pay for its passage.
